run.access_mode: Playwright (scripts/settings.mjs) + save reads + the audio engine's own counters (PSAudio.debug)
run.scope: Music, Sounds, Haptics, Notifications switches (default, apply, persist, UI matches state), player ID, version, Copy
run.summary: All 7 checks pass. The switches apply at once, survive a reload and the UI always matches the saved value. 'Sounds off' is proven by the audio engine: 0 effects played while tapping blocks, against 4 with sounds on.

coverage.notes: Defaults on; each switch turns off in UI and save; still off after reload.
Measured through the audio engine, not by ear: sounds off = 0 effects, on = 4 effects for the same taps. Mix and loudness need a human ear.

coverage.area: Haptics and notifications on a device
coverage.notes: The switches were tested; vibration and real notifications need the Android build on a phone.
